auto_hint: click to turn continuous scanning on or off
auto_waiting: continuous scanning is on - waiting for the next pass
scan_once_while_auto: Continuous scanning is on; a one-off scan will still run. Scan once now?
legend: REPLY = text received · EMPTY = 200 but no reply · FAIL = error
mode_hint: empty — the agent's default file is used
no_open_hint: browser not opened, the report is on disk
server_stale: server is an old version — restart it
empty_registry: this is a model registry (metadata), not your agent
empty_nokeys: this source has no API key
empty_notprobeable: this source is not OpenAI-compatible (anthropic/responses) — models list only
empty_hint: pick a probeable agent: python once.py --list-sources
empty_hint2: or change active_source in the dashboard
confirm_hide: Hide this model from the list?
dead_bad_model: provider does not know this id (renamed or removed)
dead_no_access: key rejected / plan exhausted / access closed
hidden_hint: dead and hidden models can be restored: use the hidden chip
confirm_delete: Delete this model from the agent's list?
confirm_delete_note: A backup of settings.json is kept; history stays.
find_confirm: Delete this model from the agent's config?
note_cf_ban: Cloudflare blocked our request (browser signature) - not the model's fault
note_network: network unreachable: could not reach the provider
note_timeout: provider did not answer in time
note_checkin: daily check-in required at the provider
note_paid: model is not in the free tier / no credits
note_not_found: provider does not know this id (renamed or removed)
note_offline: provider switched this endpoint off (paused / maintenance)
note_concurrency: too many in-flight requests from this account
note_reasoning: model returned reasoning only, no answer text
note_otpm: provider caps output tokens per minute - a short reply passes, a long one does not
note_otpm_n: output cap {n} tokens/min - long chat answers will fail
links_kind_list_url: model-list URL instead of the API root
links_kind_endpoint_url: request URL instead of the API root
links_why_list_url: baseUrl holds the model-list address. The agent appends /chat/completions to it and gets 404 - the model will never answer in chat, even though the monitor silently repairs the address and shows it alive.
links_why_endpoint_url: baseUrl holds the request address itself. The agent appends its own path again, so the path breaks and chat fails.
links_why_dup: another provider already has the same address, key and models. This entry is redundant: the model shows up twice in the agent's list.
links_dup_keeps: The working provider with the same models stays.
